config-epoch-missing.json.reason: totals name the config epoch their config version counts in

config-epoch-uppercase.json.reason: a config epoch is 32 lowercase hex digits

config-version-missing.json.reason: totals name the config version they were computed under

counted-through-instance.json.reason: counted_through is the recipient's own: epoch and sequence, no instance

counted-through-missing.json.reason: totals say which of the recipient's batches they include (null before its first)

group-invalid.json.reason: a window's group is a group ID

hour-window-misaligned.json.reason: an hour window starts at the top of the hour

models-empty.json.reason: a model set names at least one model; all models is models omitted

month-window-not-first.json.reason: a month window starts on the first at midnight

per-minute-type.json.reason: per-minute limits stay local to each gateway and are never pushed

revision-control-plane-uppercase.json.reason: the control-plane ID is 32 lowercase hex digits

revision-missing.json.reason: totals carry a revision, so a gateway can order them

revision-sequence-negative.json.reason: the revision sequence is 0 or more

window-duplicate.json.reason: one window per limit: same group (or global), type and model set (order ignored)

window-models-duplicate.json.reason: a window's model set lists each model once

window-scope-field.json.reason: a window names its group, not a scope: scope is an unknown field
